content.title: Alzheimer's Disease: Risk Factors, Testing, Treatments | Mass General Brigham
content.text: What is Alzheimer’s disease? Find out who is at most risk, the symptoms, testing, and treatment of this neurodegenerative disease in this video. Teresa Gomez-Isla, M.D., Director for the Massachusetts General Hospital Memory Division, explains that while we can’t cure Alzheimer’s, there are promising drugs being tested in clinical trials that may slow memory loss.
